text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Flower-san, you look a little sleepy. 
Did you happen to stay up late last 
night?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoops, sorry! Was it written all over 
my face?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... It's not from staying up 
late, it's from waking up so early.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, every time I grow a year older, 
I try to challenge myself to something 
new...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I grew flowers I'd never raised 
before, so I think I'll try challenging 
myself to become an early riser this year!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So, first I tried waking up just 30 
minutes earlier than usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I guess the bar was set a little too high 
for me... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Heh... No, I think it's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Steadily increasing what you can do each 
year. Even for high hurdles, doing it over 
a long-term span increases the odds of 
making it possible.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A most efficient approach. I am quite 
impressed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait, you're praising me way too much! 
Please lift your head back up~~!
